name: 63126 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63126 (Saint Louis) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63126 (Saint Louis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63126 (Saint Louis) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
